summary: Request a graceful quit that runs Electron-style quit/window shutdown hooks and can be cancelled.

target.notes: Must initiate graceful shutdown rather than Environment.Exit.

semantics.side_effects: closes windows and begins app shutdown
semantics.dom_unload: must be honored by compatible renderer

caveats: A bare Environment.Exit is not equivalent: Electron app.quit can be cancelled by window beforeunload and emits quit lifecycle events.
window-all-closed is not emitted as part of the normal app.quit path described by Electron.

tests.name: graceful quit
tests.expected_behavior: before-quit is emitted, windows are asked to close, then will-quit occurs if not cancelled

tests.name: cancelled quit
tests.expected_behavior: a compatible unload/beforeunload cancellation can prevent termination
